source: In Astro components, such as with astro-i18next, the preset reads the calls in the {0} frontmatter, in {1} and in {2} template expressions.
text: 在 Astro 元件中（例如搭配 astro-i18next），此預設集會讀取 {0} frontmatter、{1} 以及 {2} 範本運算式中的呼叫。
